assertion: benchmark methodology: bench-hit-rate.mjs reads cache_hit_pct samples from the local perf_samples table, groups them by flag state (pre-pc before the PC-A deploy cutoff, pc-a before the PC-B cutoff, pc-b after) and computes valid providerCachePct ratios (cacheRead/(cacheRead+input+cacheWrite)*100) per group, printing a mean/median/p95 comparison table
